answer: Admission auction: 100 slots open each epoch, the winning bid locking 20 epochs, the bid-reserve gap burned. Each entrant earns an umber badge maturing after 20 honest epochs; a spot check finding no real transactions revokes it, forfeiting the deposit. The badge bridges newcomers into verified trade, a meadow of trusted partners. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 tokens locked 20 epochs; one honest agent pays 50 and keeps undiluted rewards.
